comparisons.name: level_res_vs_old_res
comparisons.question: LEVEL modification over the previous residual PEFT
comparisons.direction: LEVEL_RES minus reference; negative favors LEVEL_RES
comparisons.interval_scope: Non-circular 7-origin blocks within each period, common resamples across channels/models; two trained seeds fixed. Does not include training or selection uncertainty.

combined_definition: Within each seed/channel, sum TEST-A/B errors and observed counts before channel mean; then average individual seed losses. Deterministic references broadcast for seed-paired deltas.

gpu_cost_summary.definition: Per fit: median of three block medians; group center: arithmetic mean of individual fit medians. F0 post excluded. Within-block raw 20-pass IQR remains in rows. No independent-sample confidence interval.

cpu_cost_summary.definition: Per fit: median of three block medians; group center: arithmetic mean of individual fit medians. F0 post excluded. Within-block raw 20-pass IQR remains in rows. No independent-sample confidence interval.

cost_drift.interpretation: Descriptive drift/rank checks only; no automatic correction, deletion, repetition or causal attribution.

verification_scope: Measured evidence assembled; final verification is a separate artifact.
seed_aggregation: mean individual seed losses, not prediction ensemble
